provenance.line: hec_event_to_json and raw_to_json, and the assertions in test_raw_to_json_with_metadata
provenance.note: HEC writes no _source. The converter merges the submitted event with the HEC metadata -- _time, host, source, sourcetype, index -- and nothing else, so `sourcetype` is the only key here that no Elastic or fetcher shape also uses, and it is what detection keys on. It is present only when the sender sent it: see splunk_hec_no_metadata.json for the half we are blind to.
